—Issue No. 132—
<style="stress">[Hall of Ancients Latest Updates!]</style>
<style="stress">[Mysterious Court Mage Linked to the Queen]</style>
By: Blind Mole Rat

Following Princess Peggy's failed attempt to draw the sword in the Hall of Ancients, another key figure has stepped into the spotlight—Cassadee, the court mage who accompanied her!

Our investigation reveals that Cassadee is merely a novice mage. Following her predecessor's suspicious death, she was swiftly appointed with the backing of the Queen and Princess Peggy.

Is this just a coincidence? The testimony from an anonymous insider casts everything in doubt.

"I saw it with my own eyes!" the eyewitness said, their voice trembling with fear. "Cassadee pulled out a bizarre device in the chapel! After she chanted over it, that thing began to give off an ominous glow and sound... Then all hell broke loose!"

According to our sources within the court, the Queen has been steadily consolidating her influence among the court mages over the years. It is now said that more than half the cohort stands aligned with her.

Is Cassadee a key piece in the Queen's plans? Could the disappearance of the Hall of Ancients be part of a grander design by Her Majesty?

The Savannah Eye brings you every development in the royal capital as it happens!

—Issue No. 132—
<style="stress">[Exclusive! The Unspeakable Horrors Inside the Hall of Ancients!]</style>
By: Gray Raccoon

As the mystery surrounding the disappearance of the Hall of Ancients deepens, the royal court remains a wall of silence. An exclusive interview with an anonymous royal clerk who returned from the chapel unveils disturbing details never before disclosed...

"At that moment," he recalled, his voice strained with fear, "everyone was praying Princess Peggy would draw the sword and inherit the throne. But Her Highness… she just smiled."

"It was... a cold, knowing smile of triumph that sent chills down my spine. I had a feeling she didn't care whether she could draw the sword at all… because what she truly wanted was something else!"

The royal clerk later described an even more astonishing scene when King Rolan appeared to quell the crisis following Princess Peggy's failed attempt to draw the sword.

"When King Rolan appeared, the smile on the princess' face disappeared, replaced by a look of sheer panic, as though her plot had just been exposed. Rather than showing reverence for her ancestor, her eyes darted uneasily!"

The royal clerk's statement offers a new perspective on the incident. It raises questions about Princess Peggy's possible involvement in the disappearance of the Hall of Ancients, suggesting a conspiracy far-reaching enough to alter the empire's fate.

The Savannah Eye will keep you updated!

We welcome members of the public to provide leads or information to us.

Reach us at: <style="highlight">The mailbox by the tablet in Savannah's central plaza</style>

—第132期—
<style="stress">【圣古堂牵扯新疑案！】</style>
<style="stress">【神秘宫廷魔法师疑为王后安插！】</style>
本报记者盲鼹
随着佩吉公主在圣古堂中拔剑失败在王都引发轩然大波，另一位关键人物也浮出了水面——她就是陪同公主进入圣古堂的宫廷魔法师，科丝蒂！
本报经过深入调查，挖出了一个惊人内幕：科丝蒂并非资深魔法师！她之所以能进入宫廷，是因为她的前任——一位颇有声望的魔法师，在不久前蹊跷暴毙！而就在席位空缺之后，科丝蒂便在王后与公主的擢选下上位！
这仅仅是巧合吗？一位来自圣古堂事件亲历者的匿名爆料，让一切变得更加细思极恐！
“我亲眼所见！”这位因恐惧而声音颤抖的目击者称，“在圣古堂内，科丝蒂曾取出一个我从没见过的诡异魔法装置！她对着装置念着咒语，那东西发出不祥的光芒和声音……然后，一切都变了！”
据知情人士透露，近年来，王后一直不遗余力地向宫廷魔法师中安插自己的势力。如今的宫廷魔法师阵营中，过半数已然倒向王后！
而科丝蒂，会不会就是王后精心布局在圣古堂中的一枚关键棋子？圣古堂的消失，背后是否隐藏着王后更大的图谋？
王都大小事，尽在掌握中！《赛凡纳之眼》将为您撕开真相的最后一层伪装！

—第132期—
<style="stress">【独家！消失者亲述圣古堂内恐怖一刻！】</style>
本报记者灰浣
圣古堂离奇消失事件持续发酵，王室至今讳莫如深。然而，本报记者通过秘密渠道，独家联系到了一位从圣古堂中归来、却不愿透露姓名的书记官。在他的叙述中，首次披露了诸多令人不寒而栗的细节……
“就在那一刻，”他回忆道，声音因恐惧而嘶哑，“所有人的心都为公主殿下悬着，都在祈祷她能拔出圣剑，继承大统。但佩吉公主……她笑了。”
“那不是紧张或期盼的笑，而是……目的得逞后的诡异微笑，那笑容令人不寒而栗，就好像圣剑是否拔出根本不重要，她想要的……另有其物！”
更令人震惊的还在后面。当佩吉拔剑失败、罗兰大帝的圣迹为平息危机而显现时，这位书记官描述了截然不同的一幕。
“紧接着，当罗兰大帝的圣迹笼罩大厅时，她脸上的笑容瞬间消失了！取而代之的是惊慌失措！就像阴谋被当场戳穿一样！她眼神躲闪，完全没有身为王室后裔见到先祖圣迹时应有的崇敬与坦然！”
这位勇敢揭露者的话，让我们不得不重新审视整起事件。圣古堂的消失，佩吉公主在其中究竟扮演了何种角色？这背后是否隐藏着一场动摇国本的巨大阴谋？
《赛凡纳之眼》将持续为您追踪报道！

本报欢迎热心人士提供新闻线索。
爆料地址：<style="highlight">赛凡纳中央广场区小石碑信箱</style>
